rules.rule: Tenant equality must be guaranteed on every boolean branch in WHERE or INNER JOIN; propagate only through tenant equalities.
Use every equality in a canonical join; include tenant and document/process version keys.
Resolve every table and column against schema.json.
For current DOCUMENTO state require VERSAO_ATIVA=1 and LOG_DELETE=0 on each alias; historical queries must declare historical mode.
A destination without a declared UNIQUE key can multiply rows. Prefer EXISTS, preaggregation, or deduplication at the requested full grain.
Declare and verify assumptions for relationships with confidence probable.
Use explicit projections when a participating table contains LOB columns.
Prefer modern task timestamps over deprecated date/hour pairs.
Scope FDN_USER through a tenant-filtered FDN_USERTENANT; global identity is not tenant ownership.
Prefer predicates matching index prefixes; inspect EXPLAIN on the instance.
Count at the requested grain. For multiple tenants COUNT(DISTINCT NUM_PROCES) is insufficient; distinct (COD_EMPRESA, NUM_PROCES) or aggregate root rows.
